nom: La Roche-Posay Lipikar AP+ Gentle Foaming Cleansing Oil

avis.texte: This product is a gentle cleanser for trouble skin such as eczema. It really soothes as it cleans the skin.

I have sensitive skin and this product sometimes breaks out my face. it leaves it feeling very tight and itchy. where i placed face wash there will be a red spot. it leaves me looking like i put on a red face mask.
Huge fan of this brand love the oil wash takes my makeup right off and no oil residue love love love will be getting more!
Destroyed my skin barrier. Burned, dryness, inflammation , and redness after use.

Left my skin with dry oatches on my face . Near my chin around my nose abd on my forehed . I thought maybe it was my day cream or a serum I was using but even after chtting them out my face got worse and I started noticing it was this face wash. Everytime I used it I started feeling stinging sensations and my skin felt terribly dry . My patches would get worse and worse . So when I saw similar reviews I knew it wasnt just me . Stay away. My skin usually can tolerate allot I would not call my skin sensitive so for this product to do all this to my face is shocking considering on the bottle it says sutable for babies.
I moved to the west coast and my skin dried out. Using this with my tretenoin has been amazing

I have very sensitive skin and my legs can be very prone to itchiness. It got so bad last summer that I got allergy testing. My results didn't turn up anything that seemed to be causing the increased itchiness, so my doctor recommended ditching scented body products. I still really miss scented shower gel, but not only has this product greatly decreased the itchiness, but my skin also feels way more hydrated. I also love that this comes in refill pouches to reduce waste!

I was so hopeful when buying this, but i have super dry skin and have been using a non foaming cleanser but hate the feel of it after rinsing. So i bought this foaming one to feel like my face is actually getting clean and it has dried me out so bad. Ive stopped using and hate that i spent the money on it.

Honestly don't know why I even bought with ingredients that I can't even pronounce and they all just sound like chemicals. My face was soo irritated after washing with this, it felt like it was burning

avis.titre: terrible bumps all over body and face
avis.texte: I liked this for 2-3 days so much that I went and bought extras to have one every where. Then my face and body stated breaking out in painful red pumps. AVOID!
Just a little goes a long way. It's very gentle on the skin. I feel it really cleans my face well too. Just wish they would be cruelty free. Thats why 4 stars! Might need to stop using if not.

avis.titre: I love this. I would buy this again.
avis.texte: This was my first time using this product. After using this my face doesn't feel dry and it really helps with my eczema. I would totally buy this again.
Dryed my skin out so bad it took me two weeks to recover my skin barrier

I don't understand the high rating of this cleansing oil. Why would you make a cleansing oil for dry sensitive skin and put sulfites in it? My keratosis pilaris bumps become significantly more raised and obvious. Don't go near this product.

avis.titre: Works wonders on my children's skin
avis.texte: This along with the Triple Moisturizing Cream was recommended for my son by his Dermatologist. My oldest started using it as well and it has done wonders for their skin. Their skin looks so healthy and clear with a natural glow. They have been using for almost a year now.
It cleans thoroughly without a dry uncomfortable feeling afterwards.Also great as a body wash
This is surprisingly great face wash. For such an inexpensive product, it does a perfect job getting rid of all my makeup without over drying my skin

Its not working for my skin I was using inkey hylurunic acid cleanser but when I out of that cleanser I just buy this and It's make my skin dry and bad texture in one week it's make you skin dry and rough texture.

Received a sample of this and love it so much i just bought a full size. It gets my skin smoother than i even thought was possible! Not really sure if i am supposed to use this alone or as part of a double cleanse, it feels mostly like normal facewash.

I used this for about a week and then I had to stop. I have dry skin so I figured I should try this instead of the normal bottle I get. The first day wasn't bad but the next day the skin on my face was so irritated and sensitive which isn't normal for me. I figured maybe my skin isn't used to it but then the next day my skin was SOOOO dry even after applying my moisturizer & sunscreen. Eventually the irritation got so painful I had to stop using it. as soon as I went back to the hydrating gentle cleanse my face went back to normal.

avis.titre: Feeling a bit duped, not an oil cleanser
avis.texte: Like the review title, this isn't a true oil cleanser. It feels more like a gel consistency. It does remove make up really well however it's not particularly hydrating, and as I wait for my face to dry, it does feel a bit tight and is certainly not hydrated, if a bit tight. Ill keep giving it a go just to see but I'll probably downgrade this to a body wash or see if my husband likes it.
I have tried many cleansers that claim to remove makeup. This one really works! It is gentle on the skin and very effective.

Wanted to try this because I love their purifying foaming cleanser but this broke me out in little bumps and left my skin a strange texture. Also not a true oil cleanser and has a very strange texture.

avis.titre: Gentle, Effective, and Perfect for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I can't say enough good things about La Roche-Posay's Foaming Cleansing Oil! From the first use, it made a noticeable difference in how my skin felt—clean, soft, and incredibly nourished without any tightness or irritation. Unlike many cleansers that strip moisture away, this formula gently lifts away impurities while actually strengthening the skin barrier. The texture is luxurious—it foams just enough without feeling heavy or greasy, making it perfect for both morning and night routines. Plus, a little goes a long way, so the bottle lasts much longer than expected. It's enriched with soothing ingredients like niacinamide and shea butter, which leave the skin feeling calm and hydrated. As someone with sensitive, dry-prone skin, finding a cleanser that truly cleans without causing redness or dryness has always been a challenge. This one checks every box. It's also fragrance-light, dermatologist-recommended, and safe for the whole family, which makes it even more impressive. If you're looking for a cleanser that protects your skin's natural balance while giving you a fresh, clean feeling, I highly recommend La Roche-Posay Foaming Cleansing Oil. It's truly a game-changer!

The first use I liked it,it felt really nice. but after that it made my skin really red, and it burned!! I wouldnt really consider my skin sensative either! This overall caused severe redness and burning unfortunatly!! And now the day after using it, my skin still burns when not using it, and when putting moisturizer on. Dont recommend if you have any sort of sensitive skin.

I ignored 1 star reviews saying it gave them a bad breakout. This DESTROYED my skin. I had the worst acne i have had in years and i dont get acne. I used this for a couple months chalking my acne up to stress. The day i stopped using it my skin immediately started to heal and go back to normal.

i got a mini sample size of this at my doctor's office, and i am not disappointed! i have dry, eczema prone skin, so it needs all the moisture it can get. this made my skin feel soft and it looked very hydrated after using without moisturizer.

Okay friend, look. I was a little scared buying it too. But the Lord said to buy it and boom, skin CLEAR. I'm not even lying, a new cleanser was needed and this seems to be doing its job! Along with Good Molecules products🫶🏽

avis.titre: you can skip this- not worth the hype
avis.texte: this stuff was supposed to be better than Ceraves hydrating oil cleanser that they duped. it sucks i have to use two pumps for it to fully cover my face. when you add a little water it doesnt sud up, it washes away. it doesnt even sud up without water?? its terrible. dont waste your money

avis.titre: Didn't work well on my dry skin
avis.texte: A great cleanser but I dont understand why its targeted towards dry skin.. my skin felt extremely stripped using this product which led to a lot of flaking and breakouts. If you have really dry skin go for the hydrating gentle cleanser by la roche instead of this one.

First everyone's skin reacts different to any product. Don't let a negative review keep you from trying something that might work for you. Form your own opinion. For my skin it works well and I love it... But try for yourself. And no it's not a double cleanse product. If you don't wear makeup you don't need a cleansing balm or oil. However on the days you do wear makeup Cliniques cleansing balm is perfect and then follow with this as the second cleanse

avis.titre: I buy this product all the time
avis.texte: I love this cleaning oil! It leaves my skin feeling clean and not dry!
I have dry skin, i used this cleanser for a month and broke out so bad. I have never had a product break me out so bad in my life. I stopped using and my pimples immediately started to heal

I love it. I used it for about two weeks everyday I didn't break out at all. I have sensitive skin. This wash makes my face feel smooth and hydrated. I will be buying this product again. Highly recommend.
Love this cleanser. It removes my makeup so easily. It can be a little drying but I just make sure to moisturize after

This product gives false advertising, it claims to be an oil cleanser but it is not a true oil cleanser. Oil cleansers do not get soapy with water and oil cleansing is normally used on dry skin not damp skin. This product made my skin feel dry and tight I also had an eczema like reaction to it. I tried the product for 3 days before stopping use and the flare up on my face cleared up within 2 days.
Love how it makes my skin soft. Definitely one of the best cleansers that works for me.

I have used LRP Foaming wash for ever..until I discovered the cleansing oil! Definitely my new fave. Doesn't dry my skin out, lathers well and not much scent. I put it right on my loofa and wash away!

So I used to typically double cleanse with the regular cleanser, bur wanted to switch it up and use this cleanser instead then follow up once with the regular cleanser. Absolutely horrible! It made my skin sooooo dry & flaky! Also feels more like a cleanser than an oil.

I love this product so much! It does not leave a greasy feel on the face, is not harsh to wash with and works well for alternating between it and benzoyl peroxide cleanser. I did not break out after using it!
I have sensitive skin, so finding skin care can be difficult. Made my skin feel clean & helped get off any makeup residue. Will be buying again.

Before purchasing any product I really look into the product and brand. I thought this would be a great facewash for me because I suffer from dry, sensitive skin. The first time I used it I noticed my skin felt super dry but thought it may be my skin just "getting use" to a new product. The next few days my skin became worse after using this product. It looked like I just had a chemical peel done.. thats how badly it made my skin red and dry. No moisturizer has been able to calm my skin down yet. Super annoyed that I wasted my money on a product that is suppose to be for us who have "dry, sensitive skin."

Its okay. I bought for body wash and find this doesnt get me as clean as I want. I may try it on my face as my second wash. Its fine. It works ok, there are just so many incredible oil washes these days.
only cleanser I use...leaves skin cleansed without a tripping any esthetician uses it in her office too
its not worth the money. i dont feel like it does anything special either to my skin. Ive used better oil cleansers that are cheaper so this is a no…

I bought this looking for an oil cleanser to begin incorporating in my routine. I patch tested and the patch seemed fine. The nights applied this all over my face, my cheeks and nose specifically got so red and irritating, it felt like it was stinging and almost itchy. This was the only new product i had introduced into my routine, so when i stopped using it my face went back to normal. Very disappointed in this product and was glad i could return it.

avis.titre: Worst face wash I ever used
avis.texte: Was so excited to try this face wash based off the reviews even though high priced and liked the 'vegan' aspect. Well used it for few weeks and in the fall and my skin became insanely dry, peeling and developed dermatitis all around eyes, nose and chin. Didnt think it could be this product so started to rule out all my other face products. Checked label and saw sodium lauryl sulfate as an early ingreident. Well im allergic to SLS as it causes skin peeling and dermatitis for me but because it was marked as clean i didnt bother checking label. Super disappointed that an expensive brand like this would use SLS. Switched to elemis priduxts not only has my skin cleared but its the best its ever been in years. Please avoid SLS at all costs - should not be in our skin care.
This stung my eyes so I don't use on my face BUT I use on my legs & underarms. It is an AMAZING shave oil & leave my legs SO hydrated! I'm on my 3rd bottle of this stuff.
I used this and it made my skin so dry and flaky that it burned. Would not recommend for those with sensitive skin

Would not recommend for cleansing makeup. It burns and stings the eyes so badly and doesn't take off eye makeup either. It was okay at cleansing the rest of my makeup off but I wouldn't recommend or purchase
I love this cleansing oil and this brand! I havent had any issues with this cleansing oil and im almost done with the bottle. I will definitely repurchase!

avis.titre: died the heck out of my skin
avis.texte: i saw all the good reviews, but this dried my skin out very badly. not sure what to do with the rest of it :\

avis.titre: Worst cleanser ever do not buy this
avis.texte: Trying to venture into double cleansing territory and this cleanser came highly recommended by Byrdie. Used it for the first time and had some redness - didnt think it was a big deal. Used it last night with no issues. Used it tonight and my skin is so red, tight, dry, and stinging. Im returning immediately to Ulta. Insane that a brand that is derm recommended and this line is specifically for dry sensitive skin can have a reaction like this. Do not buy it!

This seems to work well to remove makeup easily. I do a double cleanse and this is the first step. I have a tiny irritation around my eyes but if I wash it off quickly, it's ok. I like the pump bottle. All the price hikes though lately.......we could do without those!

avis.titre: It isn't terrible, but definitely not the GOAT
avis.texte: I've been using this product for about a year and my bottle is almost empty. I asked myself if I should repurchase when I'm done and my final answer to myself was no, here's why: I initially bought it because it foams, and for some reason I always like foaming washes better because I thought they were more cleansing than non-foaming washes and therefore better for my oily skin. While this cleanser does do a great job at taking my makeup off, it also does not feel especially hydrating. In fact, most times I use it I get this burning sensation and then my face ends up getting a little red and irritated. Since it was meant to be step 1 in my double cleanse, I would expect it not to feel so stripping. It is also advertised as a body wash, which I personally think it does a better job at. I used it a few times as such and my skin was always left feeling clean yet hydrated. I just wish it did the same for my face. Sadly, I am going to move on in search of other options.

avis.titre: Lipomata AP+ Gentle Foaming Cleansing Oil
avis.texte: LOVE this product it works so well for my dry skin and it even removes my makeup 10/10 ❤️😊

i had this as a sample. i didn't like as a face wash, maybe a second cleanse if my face was real dirty. anyhow- i was looking for fragrance free options for intimate wash. yes i was using scented all this time, like a fool. since this is for both face and body and it has a wonderful lather and foam, its great for cracks and crevices like toes and rear.

To my disappointment, this product does not compare to my usual Japanese/Korean brand oil cleansers. It left my face red, raw, stinging and with dry patches that were visible if I didn't apply lotion. Not sure if theres any alcohol equivalent in the ingredients. Just disappointed and a waste of money
I love this stuff, very moisturizing, really good as a face wash to boot. No strong scent.
This gets my makeup off very well and I have no black heads. I rub it in for about a minute. It helps with my dehydrated skin.

avis.titre: Do not use to remove eye makeup

Thanks to this product now I have Irritated skin and i got a dried, sensitive and irritated spot on the corner of my eyelid!

This is my absolute favorite morning wash for my mature super dry skin! I bought it two summers ago(the one befre this one that just past) and I still have a small amount left! I use it at night when I wear no makeup or sunscreen that day(stayed home). Will be getting another bottle!

I got it as a sample, ans it was so irritating ok the face. I dont know why it claims to be oil based, it doesnt feel like an oul cleanser. It hurt my eyes, dried my skin, and did not remove my makeup.
I use this as a face wash and it has been an absolute game charger for my skin. Its so hydrating and gentle. Its great for dry skin ! I LOVEEEE THIS FACE WASH
I've been using this for a few days and already noticed a difference. My skin feels so soft and hydrated!

avis.titre: Feels more like cleanser than cleansing oil
avis.texte: I've been double cleansing for a while, and this more like a second cleanser than a first. It stings my eyes, it foams up immediately (not just with water), and doesn't feel oily at all. Will be returning.
perhaps my skin type wasn't great for this. I have mixed feelings. loved the moisture and softness. didn't feel it was really cleansing it. unsure if I'd buy again.
I really like it. Foams up well, rinses cleanly, leaves no weird residue behind. I have sensitive skin, and it hasnt bothered me in a week's time.
This oil cleanser does not break down waterproof mascara and it also burns the eyes. I will not repurchase.

avis.titre: DO NOT BUY IF YOU HAVE DRY OR SENSITIVE SKIN
avis.texte: Honestly i mixed feelings for this, yes its a great cleanser for normal to oily skin but horrible for dry skin or sensitive it just made my skin feel tight, wished i could have loved this another way. But still a great product!

This cleanser has saved me when my barrier has been disrupted. But!!! It has niacinamide — which I suspect is what's causing some folks issues. I don't think people expect to find niacinamide in a cleanser, so I wanted to share that info.

The BEST cleansing wash I have ever used. I wear sunscreen as well as complete coverage make up every day and I have tried every kind of remover/wash imaginable. This is THE ONLY one that works without drying your skin! I am in my mid-60's with very dry sensitive skin for reference. What I love most is the simplicity = I use one pump on my dry face first, then I rinse that and use it it again (one pump)as a foaming cleanser. Brilliant product!! My white towel is perfectly white with no make up residue after washing :) Hooray and please don't ever discontinue.

I love the lipikar dry skin body wash/moisturizer combo. it is super light and doesn't dry the skin. I've been using this for a couple of months and could feel my skin being moisturizing after the first or second use.
I dont have sensitive skin but after using this my face started burning and now i have blotches on my cheeks i couldnt even use moisturizer because it was so sensitive and flaky

I have now used this amazing product on both of my daughters. Once on what they call rosolie and an unknown rash that appeared out of nowhere. I am grateful for it because the use of it cleared up their skin rather quickly. Thanks for making this product
My new go to facial cleanser. I love this oil cleanser. I use it on my face and neck. Not harsh on this skin, no breakouts. Just happy smooth soft skin .

La Roche-Posay Lipikar Oil AP+ Gentle Foaming Cleaning Oil may be a mouth full to say but it is a great product. You get a ton of product on the wonderful pump bottle. It really helps dry skin and it is gentle enough for even a baby.
My only complaint is that I can't currently put this on a subscription! I feel like this does a great job of cleansing my face and the hydration is undeniable. I've already bought more bottles lol.
I loved this product so much !! It helped clear my skin within a couple of days and I've seen such a difference .
perfect for double cleansing and doesn't leave my face feeling stripped. the bottle is gonna last a long time too

If you used this and have sandpaper like skin suddenly. Its this. I was so excited to use this. And by the time I used it once, I woke up with a puffy, red hot face covered in tiny bumps. Genuinely feels like sandpaper. I dont have sensitive skin, at all. Can use and try anything. Its been four days and I have stopped using and gone back to my plain old skin care. My 40th birthday is next month, I hope my skin texture is back to normal, but even after discontinuing, Im not seeing improvement.

I enjoy this body wash. I've used it on my face before as well. I have eczema on my hands and it doesn't irritate me or make my skin worse. My hands are pretty temperamental when it comes to everything really and this didn't bother me. I've used one body wash for years and wanted to try something new. I am also using Prequel's gleanser, which is fine but my skin feels cleaner with the La Roche Posay body wash. It leaves my skin feeling clean but never dry and it doesn't irritate my skin.

So I had purchased this a while back and was expecting this to be a traditional oil cleanser. It wasn't sudsy so i just stopped using it. I gave it another chance a while later and it literally changed my cleansing routine. Once I understood that it was both a cleanser with a jelly-like oily comsistency and how to use it, I purchased another bottle.
First night I used it I loved it, second day my skin is even more dry.

I Can't use everything BUT this was so wonderful!! it makes my skin feel so soft and silky. Not greasy . I even washed my face with it and my face didn't break out. This is a plus for me. I am very happy with this purchase.
I didn't understand the point of this.. It didn't do any good to my body or my face. It didn't really leave me feeling "clean", I sort of used products after using this. I just wouldn't recommend it.
I use this in the shower when i'm done working out! I like the texture and the effectiveness of this I will probably buy this again in the future
The product packaging is satisfactory, but unremarkable compared to others. The texture is good and the ingredients are of good quality, but it doesn't stand out from other similar products.
I love this brand but did not like the cleansing oil ,it burnt my eyes and left my skin oily

avis.titre: Clearer skin and no allergic reactions
avis.texte: This cleanser is perfect for my nighttime skincare routine. Its gentle on my sensitive skin and has cleared up my complexion. It foams lightly and doesn't dry out my skin. This is definitely my favorite La Roche-Posay product!
Purcahsed this on sale to try ans after one use bought 2 more. Amazing for taking off makeup yet gentle and skin felt difference after one use!

avis.titre: only safe cleanser during PD flare
avis.texte: I recently had a horrible perioral dermatitis flare that was burning and peeling and just gross. I was doing zero therapy, but out of desperation to soothe the itch/burn, I tried washing with this. WHOA! It felt soothing, and my flare was so much better the next morning. That night, I went back to using nothing, flared again the next day. So, that night I washed with this again, and it was soothed again. This will now be my go-to!

I bought this yesterday and started incorporating to my nighttime routine. Immediately after applying, I felt burning sensation on my face and neck. Turned my face and neck red! I thought it was just an initial reaction. Used it again this evening and had the same burning sensation, left me completely in pain. I'm staying away from this product!
It has a subtle scent and feels great on the skin. Not over-drying and my skin feels clean hours after washing. Perfect for sensitive skin. I highly recommend!!

I adore this and for months it's been the only soap I'm putting on my face and body. I use it as body wash, face wash, and as hand soap. It totally saved my dry skin this winter, and the probiotic support makes my deodorant work better and other parts don't smell as strong after sweating at the gym. My local pharmacy runs out often so I saw a different French brand that was advertising many of the same qualities, in a much larger bottle. I bought that and have REGRETS. It's scented and doesn't support the microbiome like this does. I want this in a gallon refill container so I can keep it stocked in every soap dispenser in my house.
This cleansing oil is something you should have. Especially during the winter months. I used it all winter and it kept my skin moisturized. There isn't much of a scent, at all.

First time buying this cleanser and defintely not my last. I love how this oil cleanser lathers. It cleans all my mascara and eye makeup off. I typically use this in a double cleansing process, I use this first and then use a gel/foaming cleanser after. Sometimes I will use this cleanser alone if I'm not wearing makeup. Im so excited that I found this staple!

For everyone complaining about it making their skin red and burning, it's probably the niacinamide. I just found out I have allergic reactions to that and bought this well before I knew that. Two days in and I started having allergic reactions again.
I use a bunch of laroche products it's amazing! But this one made my skin have some sort of reaction. The skin becomes red, itchy, burn, flaky. Not sure what's the problem here.

avis.titre: Cleared my highly sensitive acne skin
avis.texte: I am 39 and have painfully suffered from highly sensitive and hormal acne skin. I have tried just about everything (medical, drug store, high-end) with very little succes. I use this as step one in my double cleanser. I use the LRP hydrating gentle cleanser as my second cleanser. I use the LRP Triple Repair Moisturizing Cream after. This has almost completely cleared my skin. I went out in public for the forst time in years with nothing but moisturizer and sunscreen on and wasnt embarrassed to show my face. Ive repurchased three times now and will continue to.
Gentle and thorough cleansing, but leaves it my skin feeling dry and tight.

Product contains sodium laureth sulfate. I wish it didn't but I cannot get myself to continue using it because of this ingredient. Too bad. I really wanted to like it. Make it without the ingredient I'll be a forever user.

I originally got a small sample of this as a part of one of UB free gift promotions. I have dry skin, psoriasis, and hormonal acne that gets out of control when I'm on my period. This cleanser not only felt nice on my skin, but I felt moisturized through the day, any redness from my psoriasis was gone, and I noticed that during my period my acne stayed way more mellow than it previously did without this cleanser. Additionally, my period breakouts tend to take a while to resolve but this cleanser not only reduced the amount of blemishes I got, but also got rid of the ones I did get much quicker. I use a full array of skincare products, this was the only one that was different so I attribute all the changes to my skin to this product. I didn't have any issues with it. I immediately went to UB and got the full size bottle.

So, I bought this because I have had previous good experience with the brand and I wanted to try an oil cleanser. After only one use my skin seemed drier, irritated, and burned when I put my normal toner on after! Something in this irritated and dried out my skin :/ based on some reading it might be the sodium laureth sulfate

I am really like this oil based cleansing oil, it works very well and it makes my skin super smooth and soft. I've used this cleanser just to wash my entire body. I don't really use it for my face, but I do know that you can use it for your face I have a combination skin, which is oily and dry skin so this works for me, I also have used other products of this brand and they all work super amazing so I love this entire brand

I have dermatitis/eczema and i was curious to try this new one out as its an oil based compared to the other cream based moisturizer. Sadly i also noticed that my skin would get really red in my t-zone and no matter how much I moisturized after - a couple of hours later my skin would have small patches of my dry skin showing due to the cleanser being to harsh. I will be continuing to use the original one as that one never makes me have any of those side effects.
I love so many LRP products but this caused my face to become red, hot, inflamed and sore :*( hopefully LRP can help me figure it out so I can avoid this in the future.

avis.titre: made me breakout even after double cleansing
avis.texte: this may be for someone's skin, but it did not work well for mine! if you are at all acne prone i would stay away from this. probably works best for dry skin for people who don't have problems with acne! i wish i loved it, but i sadly had to return it.
It goes on clean, as well as rinses clean. It's nice to purchase a product that does 'exactly' as it is presented to do!

I started using this and within a week of use I noticed an increase in black heads and pimples. I brushed it off thinking it could just be my skin getting used to it, but now I can confirm after a month that it is definitely this cleanser.
My skin is 100% dry and this helps a lot, it doesn't get rid of my dry skin but I still love it, I use it on my face and body!

avis.titre: Best cleaner for my very sensitive skin
avis.texte: I love that this cleanser is an oil to foam, it cleans my skin of makeup but is also gental.
Thought this would be a good match for my sensitive skin, but after two uses, it left my skin red, scaly, and completely irritated around my eyes, nose, and mouth.

I struggled with dry skin and acne. I am 47. I have tried many skin care regimens. I tried samples that were given to me of the gentle foaming cleansing oil and triple repair moisturizing cream for 2 weeks. My acne is gone. My skin texture is supple and moisturized. These products are outstanding!
